title: 나의 하루: 언제 일어나요? 언제 자요?
objective: By the end, you can use ten everyday words, and say the six verbs (일어나다, 씻다, 공부하다, 운동하다, 쉬다, 자다) in their polite -아요/어요 form to say what you do in a normal day.
summary: Learn ten basic Korean words for talking about your daily routine, from getting up in the morning to going to bed.

task.title: TALK ABOUT YOUR DAY
task.line: Choose, fill in or put in order the daily-life words from page 1.

words.meaning: to get up, to wake up
to wash (yourself, your hands/face), to wash up
words.exampleMeaning: I usually wash up in the evening.
I go to work by subway.
I study Korean at the library.
I have lunch with a friend.
I work out in the park in the evening.
On weekends I relax at home.

words.meaning: to go to bed, to sleep
words.exampleMeaning: I usually go to bed at eleven.

exercises: Choose the right word: ①아침 여섯 시에 (일어나요 / 자요). / ②공원에서 (운동해요 / 씻어요).
Fill in the blank with 아침 or 점심: 낮 열두 시에 ____을 먹어요.
Write the verb in the -아요/어요 form: ①밥 먹기 전에 손을 ____. (씻다) / ②오늘은 피곤해요. 그래서 ____. (쉬다) / ③동생이 학교에서 영어를 ____. (공부하다)
Fill in the blank with 회사 or 매일: ①아버지는 ____에서 일해요. / ②저는 ____ 한국어를 공부해요.
Put these in the order of a normal day: 자요 / 점심을 먹어요 / 일어나요 / 아침을 먹어요
answers: ① 씻어요 ② 쉬어요 ③ 공부해요
일어나요 → 아침을 먹어요 → 점심을 먹어요 → 자요
